channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Netherlands hands SNMG1 command to Spain
item.description: The Royal Netherlands Navy has formally handed command of Standing NATO Maritime Group 1 to Spain following a year leading the alliance task group. The post Netherlands hands SNMG1 command to Spain first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Emergency services rehearse ferry terror response
item.description: Emergency services and counter terrorism units have carried out a large-scale multi-agency exercise testing the response to a simulated terrorist incident on a cross-channel ferry, according to Counter Terror cops. The post Emergency services rehearse ferry terror response first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Croatian Rafales assume NATO air policing role
item.description: Croatia has begun policing its own airspace using Rafale multirole fighters, marking the country’s full integration into NATO’s Integrated Air and Missile Defence framework. The post Croatian Rafales assume NATO air policing role first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Northrop delivers 1500th F-35 fuselage section
item.description: Northrop Grumman has delivered its 1,500th centre fuselage for the F-35 Lightning II programme from its Integrated Assembly Line in Palmdale, California. The post Northrop delivers 1500th F-35 fuselage section first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal, French navies train shipborne drones in Med
item.description: Royal Navy drone personnel have carried out joint training with their French counterparts in the Mediterranean, focused on sharing experience in the operation of uncrewed rotary-wing aircraft, the service stated. The post Royal, French navies train shipborne drones in Med first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: JAGM completes first vertical launch from quad launcher
item.description: Lockheed Martin has completed a successful demonstration of a 90-degree vertical launch of the Joint Air-to-Ground Missile from its JAGM Quad Launcher, according to the company. The post JAGM completes first vertical launch from quad launcher first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: GE, Lockheed test rotating detonation ramjet engine
item.description: GE Aerospace and Lockheed Martin have completed a series of engine tests demonstrating a liquid-fuelled rotating detonation ramjet intended for hypersonic missile applications, according to the company. The post GE, Lockheed test rotating detonation ramjet engine first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: New Grey Wolf helis fly first U.S. ICBM security mission
item.description: MH-139A Grey Wolf helicopters have completed their first operational security mission supporting a Minuteman III intercontinental ballistic missile convoy at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, the U.S. Air Force stated. The post New Grey Wolf helis fly first U.S. ICBM security mission first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: New US Navy mobile ship target reaches Port Hueneme
item.description: The U.S. Navy’s newest Mobile Ship Target has arrived at Port Hueneme, California, where it will be prepared for use in future weapons testing, according to the service. The post New US Navy mobile ship target reaches Port Hueneme first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Lockheed completes first NGSRI missile flight test
item.description: Lockheed Martin has completed the first flight test of its Next-Generation Short-Range Interceptor, a system being developed as a potential successor to the Stinger missile, according to the company. The post Lockheed completes first NGSRI missile flight test first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
